history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration strengthen the monitoring of delegation of authority in property management to ensure the timely completion of all mandatory and required training by staff members delegated and subdelegated with revised authorities and also ensure reconciliation of information regarding the completion of mandatory property management training within the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation implemented and requests its closure. The requirement of this recommendation to strengthen monitoring of the delegation of authority in property management to ensure timely completion of all mandatory and required training was satisfied with the release of the report on delegation of authority key performance indicators, in the fourth quarter of 2021, which includes the new key performance indicator PM- 165 on property management mandatory training in the accountability indicator monitoring tool on the management dashboard. Heads of entity are now able to monitor the completion status of the entity’s property management delegation of authority recipients, be they compliant, non-compliant or pending (training not yet completed but still within the six-month grace period after acceptance of the subdelegation).
history.board_assessment: Given that the new key performance indicator PM-165 on property management mandatory training has been put on the management dashboard to monitor the delegation of authority in property management, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
